ndvi/Ben_Tre_DBSCL.csv.source: NASA MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 (ORNL DAAC REST API, 250m 16-day NDVI, 3x3 km median at 10.0992, 106.604)

ndvi/Dak_Lak_Tay_Nguyen.csv.source: NASA MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 (Google Earth Engine MODIS/061/MOD13Q1, 250 m 16-day NDVI, median of up to ~100 native pixels (2.1 x 2.1 km) with SummaryQA 0/1 at 12.8314, 108.1282); same QA rules as core/ndvi_fetch.py, used because the ORNL DAAC API returned errors. Check on Ben Tre: 181 common dates with the ORNL file, r = 0.999, mean absolute NDVI difference 0.0044

gee/srtm_stats_Ben_Tre_DBSCL.csv.source: NASA SRTM v3 (USGS/SRTMGL1_003, 30 m): slope (degrees, ee.Terrain.slope) and elevation statistics over the 3x3 km window at 10.0992, 106.604

gee/srtm_stats_Dak_Lak_Tay_Nguyen.csv.source: NASA SRTM v3 (USGS/SRTMGL1_003, 30 m): slope (degrees, ee.Terrain.slope) and elevation statistics over the 3x3 km window at 12.8314, 108.1282

gee/imerg_monthly_Ben_Tre_DBSCL.csv.source: NASA GPM IMERG Final monthly (NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_MONTHLY_V07), mean precipitation rate (mm/hr) over 5 km around 10.0992, 106.604, converted to mm/month

gee/imerg_monthly_Dak_Lak_Tay_Nguyen.csv.source: NASA GPM IMERG Final monthly (NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_MONTHLY_V07), mean precipitation rate (mm/hr) over 5 km around 12.8314, 108.1282, converted to mm/month

gee/mod09a1_Ben_Tre_DBSCL.csv.source: NASA MODIS MODIS/061/MOD09A1 (Terra 8-day 500 m surface reflectance), 3x3 km median of clear pixels (StateQA cloud, shadow, internal-cloud flags) at 10.0992, 106.604; EVI = 2.5(NIR-Red)/(NIR+6Red-7.5Blue+1), LSWI = (NIR-SWIR1)/(NIR+SWIR1) with SWIR1 = band 6

gee/mod09a1_Dak_Lak_Tay_Nguyen.csv.source: NASA MODIS MODIS/061/MOD09A1 (Terra 8-day 500 m surface reflectance), 3x3 km median of clear pixels (StateQA cloud, shadow, internal-cloud flags) at 12.8314, 108.1282; EVI = 2.5(NIR-Red)/(NIR+6Red-7.5Blue+1), LSWI = (NIR-SWIR1)/(NIR+SWIR1) with SWIR1 = band 6

gee/smap_monthly_Ben_Tre_DBSCL.csv.source: NASA SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km surface and root-zone soil moisture (NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/008), monthly mean of the 9 km cell containing 10.0992, 106.604 (m3/m3)

gee/smap_monthly_Dak_Lak_Tay_Nguyen.csv.source: NASA SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km surface and root-zone soil moisture (NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/008), monthly mean of the 9 km cell containing 12.8314, 108.1282 (m3/m3)
